minutes.headline: Select Board ratified a three-year police union contract and appointed three reserve police officers.
minutes.summary: The board came out of executive session and ratified the police union contract in open session after counsel outlined its changes. It appointed three reserve officers, approved a used car license and a firefighters' bonfire, and pressed for action on a liquor license with no valid manager of record. It also heard a capital items update, solar PILOT updates, the school building project, and a household hazardous waste update.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified the three-year police union contract in open session after counsel outlined its changes.
The board appointed three reserve police officers.
The board approved a Class 2 used car license and a firefighters' bonfire for August 24, 4 to 9 pm.
The board began a review of a liquor license with no valid manager of record, with a follow-up letter and notice requirements set for next week.
The Lake View driving range base license was held a week, and a Unitil rate case discussion and a policy workshop on August 27 were scheduled.

why_it_matters: The police contract sets wage costs for three years that are paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, and the solar PILOT affects how much tax revenue solar projects bring in.
The liquor license review and the Unitil rate case are items residents may see again, with possible effects on local businesses and utility bills.

Policy workshop on August 27 at 6 pm.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree closely on all four votes and most decisions. Both have the contract ratification, reserve officer appointments, car license and bonfire, plus the workshop date and Unitil item.
